title: Fortune Telling
statementMd:
Marina loves Sasha. But she keeps wondering whether Sasha loves her. Of course, the best way to know it is fortune telling. There are many ways of telling fortune, but Marina has picked the easiest one. She takes in her hand one or several camomiles and tears off the petals one by one. After each petal she pronounces alternatively "Loves" and "Doesn't love", at that Marina always starts with "Loves". There are $*n*$ camomiles growing in the field, possessing the numbers of petals equal to $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ... *a*_{*n*}$. Marina wants to pick a bouquet with the maximal possible total number of petals so that the result would still be "Loves". Help her do that; find the maximal number of petals possible in the bouquet.

## Input

The first line contains an integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$), which is the number of flowers growing in the field. The second line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 100$) which represent the number of petals on a given $*i*$-th camomile.

## Output

Print a single number which is the maximal number of petals in the bouquet, the fortune telling on which would result in "Loves". If there are no such bouquet, print $0$ instead. The bouquet may consist of a single flower.
statementZhMd:
玛丽娜爱着萨沙。但她总是在想萨沙是否也爱她。当然，想知道答案的最好方法就是算命。算命的方法有很多，但玛丽娜选择了最简单的一种。她拿起一朵或几朵甘菊，逐片撕下花瓣。每撕下一片花瓣，她就交替地说出“爱”和“不爱”，并且玛丽娜总是从“爱”开始。田野里生长着 $*n*$ 朵甘菊，它们的花瓣数分别为 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ... *a*_{*n*}$。玛丽娜想要摘取一束花，使花瓣总数尽可能多，同时算出的结果仍然是“爱”。请帮助她完成这个目标，求花束中可能包含的最大花瓣数。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$），表示田野中生长的花朵数量。第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 100$），表示第 $i$ 朵甘菊上的花瓣数量。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，表示花束中可能包含的最大花瓣数，并且对该花束进行算命的结果为“爱”。如果不存在这样的花束，则输出 $0$。花束可以只包含一朵花。
